name: Errant Days
source:
Every day on her way to school, Chloe passed by a house rumored to be haunted. One day she finally gets up the courage to explore the house for herself and find out the truth...

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/datingdream.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
每天上学路上，克洛伊都会经过一栋传闻闹鬼的老宅。某天，她终于鼓起勇气亲自踏入屋中一探究竟，决心查明背后的真相……

[摘自[url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/datingdream.html]Otaku World[/url]]
